title: Unearthed
description:
S09 E02 — Valley of Egypt's Queens
The Valley of the Queens is a vast necropolis concealing some of Egypt's most miraculous tombs and powerful women; now, investigators use cutting-edge tech to explore lost tunnels and uncover the enigmatic secrets behind these ancient pharaohs.

title: Unearthed
description:
S08 E04 — Ghosts of Venice
Venice was once a fearsome superpower home to secrets, wealth, and treachery; today, scientists use pioneering acoustic imaging technology to discover the city's ancient foundations and reveal how it's still standing.

title: Unearthed
description:
S08 E08 — Egypt's Floating Pyramid
Surrounded by a mysterious trench, only one Egyptian pyramid was ever constructed to look like it floats on water; experts decode the ancient secrets of the pharaoh that are locked inside its hidden tunnels.

title: Unearthed
description:
S08 E05 — Terror in the Torture Tower
The Tower of London is a centuries-old castle with a grisly past; using cutting-edge methods, experts investigate this engineering marvel and how it transformed into an infamous prison steeped in blood and intrigue.

title: Unearthed
description:
S08 E07 — Secrets of the Sunken Empire
The secrets of the world's oldest sunken city are lost to history, but hi-tech underwater archaeology answers questions that books cannot; experts explore sunken ruins and reveal new discoveries about one of the first great empires.

title: Unearthed
description:
S09 E01 — Lost City of Persia
The sprawling city of Persepolis was capital to the first imperial civilization that conquered most of the known ancient world; experts use advanced forensic archaeology to reveal the secrets behind Persia's mysterious and dominating metropolis.

title: The Lost Colony of Roanoke: New Evidence
description: Experts use the latest forensic archaeology to investigate the true story behind the disappearance of more than 100 English colonists who settled on Roanoke Island in 1587.

title: Mysteries of the Missing
description:
S01 E06 — Lost Colony of Roanoke

S04 E01 — Pluto's Stranger Things
Evidence of alien technology around a distant star; speculation about Pluto's surface; Apollo astronauts are at a loss of words to describe an object they encountered while they approached the moon.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S06 E04 — Pluto's Evil Twin
After NASA's New Horizons spacecraft flies by Pluto, it encounters a strange alien world that shuts down the probe's computers; experts investigate if the mysterious object is an alien spacecraft hiding at the edge of the solar system.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S06 E08 — Did Aliens Nuke Mars?
A strange discovery by NASA's Mars Curiosity rover suggests the Red Planet was home to an alien nuclear war 300 million years ago; experts investigate if an extraterrestrial Armageddon transformed an Earth-like world into a wasteland.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S06 E01 — Are Black Holes Real?
Cosmologists say there are black holes throughout the Universe, but they've never seen one, and it's almost impossible to study them directly.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S06 E10 — Mystery of Spacetime
Spacetime is the secret structure that controls our universe, and this strange four-dimensional substance controls time, light, and energy; it will also determine how our universe will end.

title: Secrets in the Sand
description:
S02 E01 — The Atacama "Alien" Skeleton
Examine a tiny skeleton in Chile that set off a firestorm of alien speculation; explore a forgotten Silk Road settlement; uncover evidence of a mass sacrifice in northern Peru and visit a multi-faceted military site from the age of the pharaohs.

title: Secrets in the Sand
description: Experts uncover four global stories of extraordinary curiosities that were once concealed in the deserts of the planet.

title: Secrets in the Sand
description:
S02 E07 — Screaming Mummy and Chaco Canyon Highway
Ponder the fate of a mummy buried with an anguished look on its face; learn the secret to Sumerian power in a buried Iraqi palace; visit a lost oasis that may rewrite Arabian history; travel New Mexican roads that align with the heavens.

title: Secrets in the Sand
description:
S02 E04 — King Thutmose II Tomb & Secret Saudi Gates
Look inside the lost tomb of King Thutmose II and get new clues about Egypt's pharaohs; dust off stone hunting structures in Saudi Arabia; visit a 1,200-year-old mosque buried in the Negev Desert and inspect a 30-million-year-old predator skull.

title: Secrets in the Sand
description:
S02 E08 — Lady Be Good Wreck
Dig up a mysterious WW II bomber in the Libyan desert, then see why the carved pillars in a Turkish temple may be the world's oldest calendar; open a secret filled shrine in Jerusalem and unearth broken Iraqi bowls that have deep political meaning.

title: Dino Hunters
description:
S02 E01 — Doubling Down on Dinos
Clayton Phipps and his son Luke put it all on the line for a risky raptor fossil buried under 30 feet of earth. And the Harrises decide to go for broke to prep their multi-million dollar T. rex skull.

title: Dino Hunters
description:
S02 E02 — Duckbill Buffet
Clayton and Luke begin to excavate the deep overburden that covers the Tyrannosaurus rex site; while Mike Harris travels to Utah to prep the Cowboy Rex skull, Aaron, Jake and Tori think they're on a bucket-list discovery at the Duckbill site.

title: Dino Hunters
description:
S02 E03 — Mammoth Mass Mortality
When a wildfire surrounds his hometown, Clayton Phipps drops everything to help fight the flames; the Harris-Bolan crew excavates a new Triceratops' site; and the Abercrombie family discovers a mammoth fossil map on its ranch in New Mexico.

title: Dino Hunters
description:
S02 E04 — This Thing is a Monster
Hoping to salvage his season, Clayton Phipps hunts for valuable triceratops horns, while Mike Harris and his team believe they might be on to a world-record find; fossil hunter Andre Lujan follows a 90-year-old map to a massive mammoth site.

title: Dino Hunters
description:
S02 E05 — Monster Ceratopsian
Clayton Phipps makes a shocking discovery at the Trike site; the Harris-Bolan crew unearths what it believes might be an extremely rare ceratopsian; on the Abercrombie ranch, Andre Lujan digs up an enormous ice age mammoth tusk.

title: Dino Hunters
description:
S02 E06 — Skull Shock
With winter looming, Clayton and Luke race to excavate two massive trike skulls, while the Harris-Bolan crew searches for a crucial missing femur for their rare ceratopsian; on the Abercrombie Ranch, Andre discovers a mother-lode of Ice Age bones.

title: Dino Hunters
description:
S02 E07 — The Race Is On
Clayton gets news about the Nano sale and as a winter storm barrels in, he races to extract a rare trike tail; the Harris-Boland have finally found evidence of Ceratopsian skull; and on the Abercrombie ranch, Andre struggles to excavate a big tusk.

title: Dino Hunters
description:
S02 E08 — Rex Revealed
When a valuable fossil is trapped in a precarious location, Clayton brings in a team of horses and a helicopter to help extract it; Mike comes face to face with Cowboy Rex; Andre makes a difficult decision to save the Abercrombie mammoth.
